Browncloaks

Original: https://shrouded-lands.fandom.com/wiki/Browncloaks

The Browncloaks include at least Elwen the Snickersnee and her companions, a one-legged gnomish illusionist, a crowfolk ratter and a masked deep dwarven machinist. They are drinking in Farnsfall (11.03) and claim to have looted a hidden dragon cave - leaving behind mountains of copper pennies (08.01).

Former members

  • Albus Flidge, now a creator of clockwork
